name: Safety Checks

angles.text: The Explorers' League seeks the origins of your kind, making every recovered relic in the arid south a step toward unearthing dwarven heritage.

faq.answer: Dorgaron is an excavator with the Explorers' League stationed at the boundary between Loch Modan and the Badlands.
Dorgaron must prove to his leadership that the Badlands dig sites have not been picked clean and remain intact enough to warrant another crew.
faq.q: Why does the Explorers' League need salvaged gear and relics?

aliases: what happened to explorers league in badlands
faq.answer: Earlier digs in the Badlands suffered poor fortune and wrecked gear, leaving equipment scattered and leaders hesitant to send further teams.
faq.q: Where did the previous expeditions go wrong?

sections.body:
Dorgaron watches the southern pass from the edge of Loch Modan, eager to see the Explorers' League return to the Badlands. Past expeditions met with misfortune, yet he remains convinced that ancient relics still rest beneath the dust.

His superiors will not dispatch another crew without proof that the sites are secure and unlooted. He asks you to venture south into the arid wastes to salvage unbroken tools and unstudied artifacts from the abandoned digs.
sections.title: Proving the Digs

summary: On the border between Loch Modan and the Badlands, a dwarven surveyor named Dorgaron hopes to renew his society's excavations to the south. He needs evidence that the desert dig sites remain viable before his superiors will risk sending another expedition.
